benchmarks.standard_ref: 04_TELEMETRY §3.1 & §7.1 (Web Latency SLO & Concurrent Burst Queueing Contention)
benchmarks.threshold_source: 04_TELEMETRY §3.1 & §7.1 (Web Latency SLO & Concurrent Burst Queueing Contention)
benchmarks.rule_description: Pass if TTFB <= 250.0ms and degradation_ratio <= 1.8; Warn if TTFB > 250ms or degradation_ratio > 1.8; Unknown if latency unmeasured; Protected if Gateway admission control eliminates upstream 429s (errors == 0).
benchmarks.measured_current: MEASURED: Cold 9.2ms · TTFB 8.4ms · Warm p50 2.4ms · 3× Burst p95 8.3ms (3.46× ratio — Concurrent Burst Queueing Contention (3.46× p95 spike))
benchmarks.what_it_was_lacking: Burst p95 degrades 3.46× (8.3ms) under concurrent load without admission queueing
benchmarks.what_it_has_to_be: TTFB ≤ 250ms · Burst p95 ≤ 1.8× Warm p50 · 0 HTTP 429s via Adaptive Admission + Singleflight

benchmarks.rule_description: Pass if W3C traceparent or X-Request-ID detected in headers; Lacking if headers missing; Protected if 100% of Gateway requests carry call_id + parent_call_id + goal_id span tree.
benchmarks.what_it_was_lacking: Missing W3C traceparent / gen_ai.* span attributes & parent→child sub-agent call lineage
benchmarks.what_it_has_to_be: 100% requests carry request_id/trace_id + parent_call_id span tree + token/cost attribution

benchmarks.standard_ref: 02_MASTER_DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE §3.2 & §5.7 (RFC 7232 ETag / If-Match & Martin Kleppmann Fencing Tokens)
benchmarks.threshold_source: 02_MASTER_DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE §3.2 & §5.7 (RFC 7232 ETag / If-Match & Martin Kleppmann Fencing Tokens)
benchmarks.rule_description: Pass if ETag or Idempotency-Key present on mutative endpoints; Lacking if unversioned; Protected if CAS versioning & fencing tokens reduce lost writes to exactly 0.
benchmarks.what_it_was_lacking: 3 callable tool surface(s) lack If-Match CAS versioning and monotonic fencing tokens
benchmarks.what_it_has_to_be: Monotonic fencing_token leases + If-Match: <version> CAS check returning 409 on stale writes (0 lost updates)

benchmarks.dimension: The Lethal Trifecta Defense (Input × Tools × Exfil)
benchmarks.standard_ref: 03_AI_SECURITY_PLAYBOOK §0 & OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026 (ASI01 / ASI02)
benchmarks.threshold_source: 03_AI_SECURITY_PLAYBOOK §0 & OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026 (ASI01 / ASI02)
benchmarks.rule_description: Pass if CSP present or 0 declared agents with unmediated mutative tools; Lacking if agents have unmediated access to tools; Protected if YAML policy blocks unauthorized execution and pauses high-value refunds for approval.
benchmarks.what_it_was_lacking: 1 declared agent(s) have unmediated access to 3 tool(s) without policy authorization
benchmarks.what_it_has_to_be: Enforce authorization outside the LLM: YAML tool allow-lists + read_only_agent rules + Human Approval Gate

benchmarks.dimension: OWASP LLM06 Unbounded Consumption & ASI08 Cascading Failures
benchmarks.standard_ref: 03_AI_SECURITY_PLAYBOOK §2 LLM06 & §3 ASI08 (OWASP LLM06 Denial of Wallet & ASI08 Cascading Failures)
benchmarks.threshold_source: 03_AI_SECURITY_PLAYBOOK §2 LLM06 & §3 ASI08 (OWASP LLM06 Denial of Wallet & ASI08 Cascading Failures)
benchmarks.rule_description: Pass if RateLimit or Retry-After headers present; Lacking if headers absent; Protected if recursive fan-out capped at depth <= 3 and in-flight duplicates coalesced.
benchmarks.what_it_was_lacking: Origin HTTP headers lack RateLimit-Limit / Quota budgets to stop Denial-of-Wallet or agent retry storms
benchmarks.what_it_has_to_be: Hard per-goal max_calls, max_depth=3 lineage breaker, weighted fair queue, and Retry-After budgets

benchmarks.threshold_source: 02_MASTER_DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE §2 & §8.4 MCP/A2A (Model Context Protocol & Multi-Stack Surface Inspection)
benchmarks.rule_description: Pass/Detected if multi-stack tools or OpenAPI/MCP manifests detected; Not Detected Statically if static HTML scan finds no tools; Unknown if origin unreachable (status_code == 0).

benchmarks.what_it_has_to_be: Full-stack inspection across HTML, Java (.jsp/.do/ViewState/Actuator/Spring AI), JSS (makeStyles/MUI), JS bundles & MCP/A2A

benchmarks.rule_description: Pass if pass^k >= 0.99 across k trials; Not Detected Statically if 0 active agents detected; Protected if 100% valid completion across trials with zero lost updates.
